text: 工笔画，一只翠鸟停在枯荷梗上，羽毛以石青丝毛技法细细绘出，背景大片留白，右下角有一方朱色印章。

A gongbi painting of a kingfisher perched on a withered lotus stem, its feathers rendered in fine mineral-blue strokes, large areas of empty silk in the background, a single vermilion seal in the lower right corner.
水墨山水，远山以淡墨晕染，近景一棵孤松立于崖边，山腰有云气缭绕，山脚一间茅屋，屋旁一条小径通向溪边。

An ink-wash landscape: distant mountains in pale ink wash, a lone pine on a cliff edge in the foreground, mist drifting at mid-slope, a thatched hut at the mountain foot with a narrow path leading to a stream.
绢本设色仕女图，一位唐代仕女侧身立于庭园中，手持团扇，高髻插步摇，长裙曳地，身后有太湖石与盛开的牡丹。

A court-lady painting in ink and color on silk: a Tang-dynasty lady standing sideways in a garden, holding a round fan, her high coiffure pinned with a swaying hair ornament, long dress trailing the ground, a taihu rock and blooming peonies behind her.
墨竹图，数竿修竹自画面左下斜出，竹叶以浓墨撇出，枝干有飞白，纸色微黄，左上角落款题字。

An ink bamboo painting: several tall bamboo stalks rise diagonally from the lower left, leaves flicked out in dark ink, dry-brush texture on the stems, slightly yellowed paper, an inscribed signature in the upper left.
一幅巴洛克风格的油画肖像，一位贵族女子身着深色丝绒长裙，佩戴蕾丝领口，四分之三侧面，背景昏暗，侧光在面部形成强烈的明暗对比。
A baroque oil portrait of a noblewoman in a dark velvet dress with a lace collar, three-quarter view, dark background, dramatic chiaroscuro from a single side light.
印象派油画，夏日午后塞纳河畔，阳光穿过杨树洒在水面上，笔触松散跳跃，色彩明亮，远处有一艘白色帆船。
An impressionist oil painting of the Seine on a summer afternoon, sunlight flickering through poplars onto the water, loose broken brushwork, bright palette, a single white sailboat in the distance.
古典静物油画，一张木桌上放着铜壶、半切的柠檬、一串紫葡萄和一只白瓷盘，深褐色背景，左上方来光。
A classical still-life oil painting: a copper jug, a halved lemon, a bunch of purple grapes and a white porcelain plate on a wooden table, dark umber background, light entering from the upper left.
水彩画，一座乡村石砌小教堂，尖塔、拱形彩色玻璃窗和木门清楚可见，一条小路从前景通向门口，天空湿润的云彩用湿画法渲染。
A watercolor of a small stone country church with a spire, arched stained-glass windows and a wooden door, a path leading from the foreground to the entrance, wet-on-wet clouds in the sky.
特写人像摄影，一位满脸皱纹的老人，灰白色胡茬，柔和的窗光，焦点落在眼睛上，背景浅景深虚化。
Close-up portrait photograph of an elderly man with deep wrinkles and grey stubble, soft window light, sharp focus on the eyes, shallow depth of field.
一位身着明制汉服的年轻女子站在古镇石桥上，织金马面裙，立领斜襟长袄，手持油纸伞，背景是徽派白墙黛瓦。

A young woman in Ming-style hanfu standing on a stone bridge in an old town: gold-brocade mamian skirt, cross-collared long jacket, holding an oil-paper umbrella, white walls and dark tiled roofs behind her.
人像摄影，一位身着约鲁巴传统服饰的西非女性，靛蓝染布长袍与相配的头巾，佩戴珊瑚珠项链，纯色背景，棚拍布光。
Portrait photograph of a West African woman in traditional Yoruba dress: indigo-dyed robe with matching headwrap, coral bead necklace, plain studio backdrop, soft key light.
纪实摄影，安第斯高原上一位克丘亚老人坐在石墙边，戴着针织护耳帽，披着色彩浓烈的编织斗篷，面部被高原阳光晒得黝黑。
Documentary photograph of a Quechua elder on the Andean altiplano sitting by a stone wall, wearing a knitted chullo hat and a vividly striped woven poncho, face weathered by highland sun.
建筑摄影，摩洛哥一座庭院住宅的内部，蓝白瓷砖墙面、拱形回廊和中央喷泉，阳光从天窗直泻而下。
Architectural photograph of a Moroccan riad courtyard: blue-and-white tiled walls, arched colonnades and a central fountain, sunlight streaming down through the skylight.
野生动物摄影，一只雪豹卧在岩石上，长尾巴绕到身前，背景是虚化的雪山，长焦镜头，自然光。
Wildlife photograph of a snow leopard lying on a rock, its long tail curled in front, blurred snowy peaks behind, telephoto lens, natural light.
风光摄影，黎明时分的梯田，水面反射着粉紫色的天空，田埂的线条层层延伸到远方，山间有薄雾。
Landscape photograph of terraced rice fields at dawn, the flooded paddies reflecting a pink-violet sky, terrace lines receding into the distance, thin mist between the hills.
微距摄影，一朵紫色番红花的花蕊特写，金黄色花粉粒清晰可见，背景是柔和的绿色散景。
Macro photograph of a purple crocus in close-up, golden pollen grains clearly visible on the stamens, soft green bokeh in the background.
